pages.title: Equipment Attributes
pages.text: Every $(item)tool$() and $(item)armor$() piece may have a chance to provide extra $(thing)attributes$().

This workbench lets you reroll your equipment's $(thing)attribute$(), using your $(thing)exp$() and $(item)reforge scroll$(). $(br2)There are $(bold)3 tiers$() of scroll in total, each with different level of attributes.

pages.title: Reroll
pages.text: You can use $(item)lapis lazuli$() on the item with your anvil to reroll the $(thing)attributes$().

pages.title: Reroll
pages.text: You can use $(item)diamond$() on the item with your anvil to upgrade the $(thing)attributes$().
